context.instruction: 完整任务：初始红色方块在桌面，左右臂空手、夹爪打开。由左臂抓起方块，完成双臂交接；左臂释放后右臂独立持物，由右臂搬到蓝色目标区域、松开，并使方块稳定放置。你从抓取前接管，自主决定全部数值 TCP 目标、夹爪操作和动作次序。目标区域中心及尺寸见 task_policy。不得把抓取、接取或退出阶段当作整任务完成。done=false 时给出非空动作组；done=true 时 actions 必须为 []，表示停止并被动观察2秒。末端目标使用给定的共同世界坐标和四元数约定。仅输出给定JSON schema。

conventions.quaternion: unit quaternion [w,x,y,z], Link6 orientation in world
conventions.tcp: mean of the actual two inner pad face centres; offset depends on measured gripper configuration
conventions.opening_fraction: 0 closed command, 1 open command; measured gap is actual_pad_gap_m, not this command
conventions.execution: one tcp OR gripper operation per named arm. sequential follows list order. parallel overlaps both operations in shared physics steps. Omitted arm holds drive targets. No automatic obstacle rerouting or target correction.
conventions.time: physics paused during inference; execution advances physics. Not real-time asynchronous control.

task_policy.initial_condition: cube on table; both arms empty; both grippers open
